manufacturer_sources.finding: HUAWEI Australia confirms the WATCH FIT 4 product and Australian colour/configuration offering but does not expose a single hardware model code on the indexed product page.

manufacturer_sources.name: HUAWEI official user guide
manufacturer_sources.finding: HUAWEI's official WATCH FIT 4 / FIT 4 Pro user guide applies to SYA-B09, SYA-B19 and SYA-B29, so the generic WATCH FIT 4 product family contains more than one hardware code.

safety_notes: The generic Australian catalogue row does not contain evidence selecting SYA-B09 versus SYA-B19.
Do not populate a model number solely from a global family mapping when multiple manufacturer hardware codes exist.
No active catalogue row currently uses SYA-B09 or SYA-B19, but absence of collision is not identity proof.
No live catalogue row is changed by this evidence package.
A future model-number update requires exact Australian configuration evidence plus explicit human authorization and a fresh dependency/collision recheck.
